data.subject: Re: Vendor shortlist for the Q4 RFP
data.body:
Hi Marcus,

On Sept 9 you wrote: "I'll get you the full vendor list by end of day Friday." Today is Sept 23, so we're 12 days past that date. You've already sent eleven of the thirteen vendors (Sept 22), leaving Delacroix Freight and Halvorsen Group outstanding. Could you please confirm you'll deliver those two by Thursday, Sept 30, or let me know an alternative date that works for you?

Thanks,

Sam
